- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh: lines 2297-2315 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: When parent metadata contains the `(default branch)` sentinel, the code clears `RB_FOLLOWUP_INTEGRATION_BRANCH` but retains `RB_FOLLOWUP_TRACKING_ISSUE`, allowing a pattern-matching `PR_BASE_REF` to repopulate the branch while retaining the parent tracking issue and producing cross-project lineage.
  WHY: The follow-up body can contain `Tracking issue: #4001` with `Integration branch: orchestrator/project-249`, causing `scripts/resolve_integration_ref.sh` to route plan/implement runs to the wrong project branch; severity was reported as blocker and major.

- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh: lines 789-832 (_resilient_phase_swap function: GET at line 794, terminal-label guard at lines 813-820, full-replacement PUT at lines 823-825) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_resilient_phase_swap` checks terminal labels from a stale GET snapshot and then replaces the entire label set from that snapshot, so a concurrently added `ai:merged` or `ai:closed` label can be silently removed.
  WHY: `issue_pr_status` can add a terminal label after the GET and before the PUT, allowing the PUT to install a non-terminal label and recreate the terminal-to-non-terminal race; severity was reported as blocker and major.

- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh: lines 2326-2330 (the `Follow-up lineage:` log output) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: When `RB_FOLLOWUP_TRACKING_ISSUE` is populated but `RB_FOLLOWUP_INTEGRATION_BRANCH` is empty, the lineage log reports `integration branch none` instead of indicating that the follow-up will resolve to the default branch.
  WHY: The non-empty tracking-issue line prevents the default-branch diagnostic branch from running, reducing observability for the sentinel and malformed-pattern paths; severity was reported as major and nit.

- changelog.d/4379-followup-metadata-and-merged-label-race.md: the "New regression tests" row — changed from 10 to 11 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The changelog claims 11 regression tests, but the cited test additions and current test accounting produce 13.
  WHY: `CLAUDE.md §20` requires real, verifiable changelog numbers, and the fragment will be folded verbatim into `CHANGELOG.md`.
